reason: I have refused third-party cloud tools for years over confidentiality fears, and storing files in Google Drive does not protect against an assistant accidentally moving or deleting the folder. I would stick to testing the free sandbox before I would ever consider paying.
objection: If files stay in our Google Drive, what happens if an assistant accidentally deletes or moves the folder?
would_change_my_mind: Guaranteed folder-protection mechanisms against accidental deletion in Google Drive and peer validation at my monthly study circle that client confidentiality is 100% airtight.
